# Find human skulls or skull parts (locations & map for challenges)

![Find human skulls or skull parts (locations & map for challenges)](/uploads/576_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

There are always challenges in Fallout 76 that ask you to find human skulls or skull parts. Currently there are e.g. the challenges of the mini season “After in the Crypt”.

## Skull parts that count towards the challenges

- Skull
- Skull face plate
- Skull-eye socket
- Human jaw
- Skull fragment
- Skullcap bones
- Skull without skullcap
- Upper part of the skull

## Locations with skulls or skull parts

- 22x Braxon high quality medical supplies
- 15x north of Clancy Manor
- 25x around Dark Hollow Manor (but not easy to find)
- 15x Safe 'n' Clean disposals to Whitespring staff entrance
- 14x Palace of the Twisted Path
- 14x Big Maw
- 12x North Kanawha Lookout
- 11x Black Bear Lodge to Crater
- 10x Sunnytop ski slopes
- 10x Daggers Den
- 10x Morgantown Airport
- 9x Camden Park
- 9x Hornwright Proving Grounds #02
- 9x Pleasant Valley & Top of the World
- 8x organ cave south
